sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 100 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.

[Incandescent Rage] Shiranui or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
